Just curious as to what the readers like.
Shrooms or LSD, which is your favorite and why?

I've done both real and the synthetic analogs of both, so I'll say my piece on each (not talking about the NBOMe series, either)

1P-LSD and LSD are almost identical in every single way. The only thing I noticed was that LSD lasted a little longer, and was slightly more visual. 1P-LSD had a great time-dilation though. Other than that, they're identical.

4-AcO-DMT and Psilocybin are similar, but not QUITE the same. The body high between the two, and the headspace, is similar. That said, 'shrooms themselves are quite a bit more mind-fucking than 4-AcO-DMT, as well as much more nauseating. 4-AcO-DMT has a much more controlled, cleaner feeling trip, but I have yet to find a dose of 4-AcO-DMT that rivals what I felt on 1/16th of actual 'shrooms.

Down to which is my favorite, they both have their different qualities that I like. Shrooms and 4-AcO-DMT bring you to that essence of DMT-land, especially with closed-eye visuals and fantasy. That said, neither really match actual DMT, but they remind me very heavily of DMT's themes. I especially enjoy them for day tripping.

LSD and 1P-LSD I love for their headspace, visuals, and duration. I didn't find either nearly as mind-fucking as shrooms, and I enjoyed the body high a considerable amount more than shrooms. The fact that it is tasteless and has almost no nausea on the onset, as well as a relatively smooth and steady onset.

Overall, I prefer LSD or 1P-LSD to Shrooms. I'd say in order, it'd be

LSD>1P-LSD>4-AcO-DMT>Shrooms
